name: ${ts.npm.package.name}
description: FHIR TypeScript model definitions (DSTU2, DSTU3, R4, R4B, R5) generated by hapi-fhir-tinder.

scripts.publish-if-new: if [ -n "$(npm view "$npm_package_name@$npm_package_version" version 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "$npm_package_name@$npm_package_version is already published, skipping"; else npm publish --access public; fi
